instruction:
The init file is located at C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. You need to import it via Revit's "Open IFC" feature (File > Open > IFC) before doing the task.

Eight Unit Duplex Retrofit IFC

This task starts from init.ifc and uses the local reference image init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into an eight-unit duplex layout and export the completed model as result.ifc in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains result.ifc, and result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 24 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, and 2 IfcStair entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token living kitchen at least 8 times, bedroom at least 8 times, and bath at least 8 times.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
